description.en-US:
A Beautiful and Feature-rich Music & Video Player with YouTube Support, Built in Flutter

Don't forget to 🌟 star the repo if you like the project ^^ Intro

Take the tour for a quick look if ur new or wanna discover :3 The features section below mentions main things only, so visit the docs to see everynya about namida ^^ Sections

- Features - Library \& Indexing - Look \& Feel - Sound - Streaming & YouTube - Video Integration - System Integration - Others - Some additional cool features - Screenshots - Usage Preview - Installation - Android Permissions - Translate & Contribute - Community - Companion Apps - Donate - Special Thanks - LICENSE 🎉 Features

Everything you might expect from a music player, in addition to the following:

- Powerful Indexer & Tag Editor, powered by taglib. - Artists & Genres Separators. - Prevent Duplicated Tracks, Minimum File Size & Duration. - Folders-based Library, with excluded folders. - Sort by almost any track or album property.

whatsNew.en-US:
it's jellyfish season! jellys from all across the deep oceans are approaching namida, is it an invasion?! or a targeted attack by commander @[Tsuune](https://t.me/TsunekiHouse)? don't worry, a protective shield keeps them away.. unless you invite them from `settings -> theme -> jelly icon`. take a look at them beautiful jellys, but careful not to keep them there for too long ^^

### ✨ Highlights:

- **Cross device sync**: keep your library, history, playlists & settings in sync between devices.
- **Stats & Your Year**: charts about your listening habits and a year-in-review page, shareable in a tap - plus a slider in most played to hop between time ranges, and a button on each listen to open its range.
- **Smart playlists**: playlists built from rules that keep themselves up to date, with the same power available in search.
- **Subtitles & captions** for videos, and a big lyrics upgrade - a new provider, subtitle formats (srt/ssa/ass/sbv), a floating lyrics window on desktop & a simple single-line view.
- **Better player**: widescreen layout, lock button, long press shortcuts on the buttons (2x speed, restart, rewind, fast forward) and smoother track switching animations.
- **Import your data**: history from spotify & listenbrainz, playlists from jellyfin/subsonic servers.
- **Brand new tagger**: reading and writing tags is much faster and far more reliable, and the tags editor now suggests existing values as you type.

# hi guys ^^ v6 arrives! new app icon, design refreshes, stable windows and cool new features!

## 🎉 New Features Highlight:
   - Web servers support (add as a folder in indexer settings)
      - Subsonic (Navidrome, Airsonic, Gonic, etc)
      - Jellyfin
      - WebDAV
      - Samba (SMB v2/v3)
   - Resume where left off, for playlists/queues/albums/artists/etc
      - mark last played track in each list
      - scroll to currently playing track
   - Resume on connect (headset/etc) & button to toggle mono audio
   - Change audio track for local videos
   - Swipe to seek & long press for 2x speed in video player
   - New mixes in homepage (lost partners & discover)
   - Allow changing pitch by semitones
   - New repeat mode (shuffle all) when queue ends, replays the queue shuffled
   - Long press play next/last/after to move item instead of copying (if done from player queue)
   - Cleanup yt search results
   - Search suggestions for yt
   - Option to convert playlist to/from m3u
   - Option to disable artwork caching
   - Option to exclude file extensions

## ⚙️ Miscs Highlight:
   - Change app icon, and add more icons
   - Design refreshes (menus/buttons/etc)
   - UI fixes and improvements
   - Performance improvements (finding missing tracks/matching for imported history/etc)
   - Better translations with plurals
   - Better support for android auto/wearables/etc
   - Allow fetching yt notifications without membership
